sloka: प्रतिगृह्य च ताम् अर्चाम् उपविष्टम् स राघवम् ।भरद्वाजो अब्रवीद् वाक्यम् धर्म युक्तम् इदम् तदा ॥२-५४-२०॥
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca tām arcām upaviṣṭam sa rāghavam ।bharadvājo abravīd vākyam dharma yuktam idam tadā ॥2-54-20॥

translations.english: Rama accepted the hospitality of Bharadwaja and took a seat in front of the sage, who spoke to him these words in conformity with righteousness:
